summary.name: CleanMyMac
summary.one_liner: CleanMyMac is a Mac maintenance app that cleans junk files, removes malware, speeds up performance, uninstalls apps completely, and organizes storage, including cloud storage.
use_cases: free up disk space on a Mac
find and delete duplicate or similar photos
clean up cloud storage and redundant local copies
summary.what_it_does: The page describes CleanMyMac as a Mac cleaner with a Smart Care routine that combines deep cleaning, threat scanning, performance boosting, software updates, and storage decluttering. It claims to remove hidden system junk and outdated files to reclaim space, and to detect malware hidden in software. It can uninstall apps along with their leftover data and update installed software. It also finds duplicate and similar photos, locates large and forgotten files, and reveals large files and redundant local copies related to cloud storage. The page says it controls memory and CPU load, though it gives no technical detail on how.
notable: Smart Care routine that runs five maintenance tasks in one pass
Uninstaller that removes apps and leftover data
Cloud storage cleanup for large files and redundant local copies
caveats: Pricing and paid tiers are not stated on the page
Performance and junk-removal figures are marketing statistics with no methodology given
Listed on the App Store for Mac, per the awesome-mac listing
